title: Cardinal Morosini, legate in France, to Cardinal Montalto, 1588-89, 36 cipher enclosures (AAV Segr. Stato Francia 22, DECODE R18-R22, R27-R49, R51-R58)

documents.shelfmark: AAV Segr. Stato Francia 22, items 22/1-28, 22/30-31, 22/34-37 (DECODE R18-R22, R27-R49, R51, R52, R55-R58)

plaintext.source: No decipherment found; clear duplicates of the covering letters only (R18/R19 DOC_1806/1807). No edition of Morosini's legation found (searched 19 Sept 2026).

transcription.source: DECODE volunteer transcriptions (2017), digit by digit
transcription.notes: Count is single digits, not code groups: the 1-3 digit homophones run on without separators, so group count depends on the segmentation. Off-list dotted codes are thought to be transcription slips, not checked against images. Measured on the concatenation of decode/DOC_R*_D16xx-D18xx.txt (37 files for 34 records, D1806/D1807 clear duplicates excluded) with --width 1.

documents.shelfmark: AAV Segr. Stato Francia 22, items 22/32-33 (DECODE R53, R54)

plaintext.source: No decipherment; only Lasry's partial key reconstruction (DECODE 'F22b', 2020).

transcription.notes: Single digits counted (785 R53, 653 R54 by digit count). Some '?' digits in the transcription. Measured on DOC_R53_D1717_1717.txt + DOC_R54_D1825_1825.txt concatenated, --width 1.

system.summary: Meister no. 40 (1587): homophonic letters, clusters and common words in 1-3 digit figures run together without separators, three-digit dotted nomenclator, nulls 8x; R53/R54 use a second syllabic key (F22b).

diacritics.note: dot on the middle digit marks a nomenclator code (first digit in F22b)

system.notes: Decoded by beam search over segmentations scored with the shared it-cinquecento 5-gram model (decrypt.py). Null rule: 8 plus any following digit.

prior_solution.where: Key printed in Meister, Die Geheimschrift im Dienste der paepstlichen Kurie (1906) no. 40; Lasry's partial reconstruction on DECODE R18 (DOC_3175, Oct 2020) with the note 'full key in Meister', and his partial F22b key; no plaintext posted, records listed 'partially decrypted'.

conditions.human_role: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login and passed its session cookie to the model, set up Claude Code and posed the problem; no target-specific intervention recorded.

solution.what: Fetched the DECODE records R18-R58 (transcriptions, images, attached key documents); identified R23-R26 and R50 as other material.
Took the key from Meister 1906 no. 40 (scan and Lasry's reconstruction attached to R18).
Wrote decrypt.py: beam search over 1-3 digit segmentations with the Italian 5-gram model, nomenclator for dotted codes.
Read 34 of 36 enclosures end to end; per-item summaries written.
Applied Lasry's partial F22b reconstruction (~70 elements) to R53/R54.
Searched for an edition of the legation (Acta Nuntiaturae Gallicae); none found.
Partial-reading audit: listed remaining gaps (F22b letters, off-list dotted codes, item 22/29) and open escalation steps.

outcome.method_basis: Meister 1906 no. 40, the key printed for Morosini's legation, with Lasry's partial reconstruction attached to DECODE R18 before the attempt, read 34 of 36 enclosures; unseparated 1-3 digit homophones were segmented by a beam search with an Italian 5-gram model.

gaps.item: R53, R54 (items 22/32-33, Tours and Moulins, spring 1589)
gaps.detail: second syllabic key F22b; only Lasry's partial reconstruction (~70 elements); Meister prints only no. 40

gaps.item: dotted nomenclator codes outside Meister's list (162, 191, 250, 516, 617, 716, 770; ~1 per page)
gaps.detail: most look like transcription slips of a dotted digit; not checked against the images

outcome.notes: Class read (21 Sept 2026): the 34 Meister-key records read end to end; only R53/R54 (about 0.6% of digits, second key F22b, no further key material) stay open, listed in gaps. fraction_read estimated: Meister-key digits 232,557 of 234,005 (99.4%) read, less ~1-3% single-letter slips and off-list codes; R53 not decoded, R54 decoded only in part. Class read in part because R53/R54 are not read.
